name: Crumbling Path
hint: Pale cracked tiles hold you once. Step off and they are gone forever.

name: Claim It
hint: A star pad only pays out when the block is standing upright on it.

name: Slipstream
hint: Ice will not let you stop. You keep rolling the same way until you leave it.

name: Needlepoint
hint: A pin is a spire of rock — it holds you standing, never lying down.

name: Wormhole
hint: Land upright on a portal and it throws you to its twin.

name: One Way Down
hint: Every crumble tile is a door that locks behind you. Order matters.

name: Frostbite
hint: Glass under ice. You will not get the chance to stop and think.

name: Pinwheel
hint: Pins force you upright; glass forbids it. Read the ground before you roll.

name: Gate and Gone
hint: The bridge is one trip only if you burn the crumble tiles getting there.

name: Constellation
hint: The goal is sealed. Claim every star on the island before it opens.

name: Thin Air
hint: Glass and crumble share one rule: never linger.

name: Cold Snap
hint: A slide across ice can burn a crumble tile you were saving.

name: Skywire
hint: Pins hold a standing block. Portals move one. Chain them.

name: Twin Gates
hint: Two switches, two bridges, and only one order that gets you home.

name: Collector
hint: Star pads demand your full weight, and the goal will not open without them.

name: Glacier
hint: A wide sheet of ice. Find the one lane that does not run out.

name: Ashfall
hint: Half the island is one-use. There is no walking it back.

name: Pincushion
hint: Stand on pins, lie across glass. Get it backwards and you are gone.

name: Relay
hint: A portal is a shortcut and a trap — it only fires when you land upright.

name: The Vault
hint: Stars first, bridge second, goal last. No shortcuts.

name: Shatterline
hint: Glass over crumble over void. Nothing here forgives a second visit.

name: Black Ice
hint: You cannot stop on ice and you cannot lie down on a pin.

name: Waypoint
hint: Portals rearrange the island. Crumble tiles make sure you only get one look.

name: Lattice
hint: Two bridges, a heavy switch and a floor made of glass.

name: Stardust
hint: Two kinds of star, one sealed door. Take every one.

name: Freefall
hint: The island eats itself behind you. Commit to a route.

name: Mirror Halls
hint: Four portals and a gate. Map the pairs before you move.

name: Deep Freeze
hint: Ice, glass and crumble in the same breath. Slow down — you cannot.

name: The Machine
hint: Three gates, a pin field and a star you will have to earn twice over.

name: Endgame
hint: Everything the islands taught you, in one long breath. Good luck.
